resolutions.researcher_notes: RESOLVES this row's own deep-sweep recommendation ('find the actual September 2020 egyptoil-gas.com report it originally pointed to, via a fixed article/PDF URL, not the paginated index') -- this IS that article. Its crude table lists 'Ras Shukheir-Asyut: Ras Shukheir -> Assiut Refinery, 280 km, 20/22 in, capacity -', an exact match to the sheet's Diameter='20,22'. NOTE the same table row disagrees on LENGTH (280 km vs the sheet's 340.00 km) -- flagged as a separate spec concern on this row; diameter is cited here, length is not touched. Single source -> medium. Hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout on the article's embedded PDF (Issue 165, 6 Sep 2020, 4 pp). url_verifier returns 200 but its substring screen false-negatives on this document: the page serves the report as a large embedded PDF, and the crude and gas infrastructure tables are laid out side by side in two columns, so text extraction interleaves adjacent-cell text. Encoded ok=true/contains_value=true deliberately per the standing rule that a screen miss is not a verdict.

No source found names an owner/operator specifically for the Ras Shukeir-Asyut oil pipeline. A general almerja.com statement that Petroleum Pipelines Company (PPC), an EGPC subsidiary, administers Egypt's petroleum pipeline network was considered, but it does not name this specific line in its example list, so per the no-orphan/specific-attribution standard it is not used to support Owner1=EGPC for this PID.
